title: Corrupted ground-truth workbook (`gt_01_golden.xlsx`) contains LibreOffice Multiple Operations (`TABLE(...)`) pollution in 65 cached cells and fails its own verifier
evidence: The sole verifier `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, weight 1.0) compares the recalculated output workbook (`output_path` run through `managed_recalculated_xlsx` with `freeze_datatable_formulas`) against the un-recalculated cached values in `gt_01_golden.xlsx`. However, `gt_01_golden.xlsx` was saved by LibreOffice after its destructive `TABLE(...)` (Multiple Operations) evaluation ran across the four sensitivity tables in `Ex 1 - LBO!AG18:AK49`. As documented in `libreoffice.py`, LibreOffice's `TABLE(...)` evaluation overwrites every interior sensitivity cell with the base-case string `'2.4x/19%'` AND strands the live model cells with the last boundary inputs of each table (`C31` Offer Share Price Premium = 0.34 instead of 0.24, `C20` Exit EBITDA Multiple = 18.2034 instead of 14.2034, `M17` = 0.137, `M27` = 0.264, `C11` M&A Purchase Multiple = 17.81209). Consequently, 65 cells outside the sensitivity tables in `gt_01_golden.xlsx` store corrupted cached values that contradict their own formulas (`Ex 1 - LBO!C32` has formula `=+C30*(1+C31)` where `C30=81.73, C31=0.24` = `101.3452`, but cached value `109.5182`; `C11` has formula `=+C20` = `14.2034`, but cached value `18.2034`; `C34` has cached `11968.0394` vs formula `11074.9021`; `F21` has cached `8987.8161` vs formula `8101.8239`; plus `Ex 1 - LBO!U17:U54`, `X23:AC26`, `Ex 2 - Valuation Bridge!C3,C4,C8`, and `Ex 5 - M&A!C75:X75,K79:U81`). Because `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` freezes data-table formulas before recalculating the submission, any repaired workbook (and even `gt_01_golden.xlsx` itself when graded against itself) evaluates from the true uncorrupted model inputs (`C31=0.24, C20=14.2034`) and scores 0.0 (`FAILED - regression 0.9970, modification 0.9657. 65 cell error(s)`).
confirmation: gt_01_golden.xlsx 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C11 '=+C20' caches 18.2034 while C20 caches 14.2034, and C32 '=+C30*(1+C31)' caches 109.5182 vs 81.73*1.24=101.3452; F22 =SUM(F18:F21) caches 11510.77 while F18:F21 sum to 12412.84, and U41 =+M17 caches 0.137 while M17 is 0.092. fix: gt_01_golden.xlsx: the 65 stale cached values left over from LibreOffice's data-table substitution are replaced with the base-case values from the verifier's own forced recalculation, which freezes data tables (Ex 1 - LBO C11 18.2034->14.2034, C32 109.52->101.35, F20:F28, C34, C37, U17:U54, X23:AC26; Ex 2 C3/C4/C8; Ex 5 C75/J75/Q75/X75, K79:U81). Formulas are unchanged. The patched GT scores reg 1.0 / mod 1.0 locally, where the original scored reg 0.997 / mod 0.966.

title: Every cell in the ground-truth sensitivity tables holds the same base-case string
evidence: In the GT, every cell of all four sensitivity grids ('Ex 1 - LBO'!AG18:AK22, AG27:AK31, AG36:AK40, AG45:AK49) is cached as '2.4x/19%'. The cells are =TABLE(...) formulas that LibreOffice wrote out, and none of them varies across the exit-multiple, revenue-growth or M&A-multiple axes. A working sensitivity table would give a different MOIC/IRR in each cell. These cells all go from #REF! in the input to a value in the GT, so all of them are graded modification cells. The answer key rewards flat, meaningless grids. A correct, Excel-style data table that computes different values in each cell would be marked wrong.
confirmation: Every cell in gt_01_golden.xlsx 'Ex 1 - LBO'!AG18:AK49 sensitivity grids (=TABLE(...) formulas) caches the same string '2.4x/19%', while the input has #REF! there. So these graded modification cells reward a flat grid, and a real data table would be marked wrong.
fix: answer_position for 'Ex 1 - LBO' changed from B1:AK95 to B1:AF95, AG1:AK17, AG23:AK26, AG32:AK35, AG41:AK44, AG50:AK95. This leaves out only the four 5x5 data-table result grids (AG18:AK22, AG27:AK31, AG36:AK40, AG45:AK49). In those grids every GT cell holds the same string '2.4x/19%', and the verifier freezes data tables to the submission's own caches, so a real sensitivity table cannot match. The row/column headers and every other cell are still graded.

title: The ground-truth workbook fails its own verifier: its cached values are left over from the data-table substitution
evidence: I ran the verifier's own pipeline (managed_recalculated_xlsx, then score_workbooks) with gt_01_golden.xlsx as the output. It returned regression 0.997 (the pass threshold is 0.998) and modification 0.9657, with 65 cell errors. The scoring is all-or-nothing and this is the only check (weight 1), so the score is 0. The cached values in the GT are values the data tables plugged in, not the base case. For example, 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C11 has the formula =+C20 and a cached value of 18.2034, but C20 is cached as 14.2034.
